name: Pi Run Tool
description: Runs one tool call the last turn asked for. Belongs inside a multi-instance batch (see pi-default-loop.bpmn's tool_batch) so each instance gets its own call.

properties.label: Tool call
properties.description: FEEL expression yielding the tool call to run: a call object, an index into the turn's batch, or omit to run the single unanswered call (fails if more than one is outstanding).

properties.label: Tool name
properties.description: Process variable the run tool's name is published to.

properties.label: Terminate
properties.description: Process variable set when this tool's result asked the batch to terminate.

properties.label: Is error
properties.description: Process variable set when the tool call failed.
